name: Stretch
description: Plays what you play many times slower at the same pitch: a phrase becomes a slow cloud that trails far behind you and, when it has fallen too far back, runs up to the present again.

params.name: Stretch
params.description: How many times slower the sound is played back. Low settings follow the phrase at a crawl; high settings hold each moment for a very long time.

params.name: Window
params.description: How much sound is taken in at each moment. Short keeps some of the rhythm and blurs the pitch; long is glassy and exact and smooths every attack away.

params.name: Diffuse
params.description: How much the sound is scattered. Low keeps notes pure and still like glass; high dissolves them into a shimmering, breathing cloud.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between your playing and the stretched cloud. Fully up leaves only the cloud.

params.name: Catch Up
params.description: How long the reader takes to run back to the present. Short is a soft jump; long sweeps quickly through everything it had not reached yet.

params.name: Freeze
params.description: On stops the reader and the memory where they are and holds that moment as a steady drone. Off lets the phrase go on from the same place.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Leans the colour of the cloud. Left of centre takes the highs off for a darker, softer cloud; right of centre takes the lows off for a thinner, airier one.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far the cloud spreads to the sides. At zero it keeps the stereo image that was played; turned up its partials lean left and right and still hold in mono.

params.name: Memory
params.description: How far behind your playing the reader may fall before it runs up to the present again. Short keeps the cloud close to what you just played.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit and kit::Stft: a live extreme time stretch that reads slowly through a memory of the input and resynthesises each moment from its spectrum, with a phase vocoder for pure tones and scattered phases for a diffuse cloud.
